cohort: The study included 110 premature infants (cases) and 121 normal infants (controls) whose PON2 A148G and S311C polymorphisms were genotyped.
finding: The AA genotype of PON2 A148G polymorphism and the CC genotype of PON2 S311C polymorphism were associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, and the A148G polymorphism also influenced infant birth weight.
